id./param/scenario/cs/b_020_cs_040.pack|cs_: "I seem to have lived a long, terrible dream, ever since the day you were born.
"I have heard of my deeds, though I remember nothing. I have wronged my people... and you.
"I do not ask forgiveness. I shall repay this sin by protecting my people.
"{var:1}, do you remember what happened at Yggdrasil?
"I see... I remember nothing. Only that something that possessed me seemed to leave.
"Then I fainted, and when I woke, I had been carried to this bastion.
"Tell me one thing, {var:1}. My daughter, Jade... is she alive?
"The Hero has returned! Once again, he has rescued stranded people!!
"Our Hero returns. You may not wish it, but please go and greet him."
